form: CCSI Online — project / revision / coil navigation (DX)
captured_from: Live on coil.ccsi.ie 2026-07-04: projects list /UserProjects and project FullDetails/351437 (project 2803, revision 537707). Handlers are parameterized by ids READ FROM THE DOM, never hardcoded — the ids below are examples only.

open_project.how: navigate to /UserProjects/FullDetails/{projectId}. Find {projectId} from the projects list row link (href UserProjects/FullDetails/<id>). The list is date-filtered — widen From/To or use the project search box (a read-only filter) if the target project isn't shown.

duplicate_quote.control: Project Revisions row action, title 'Copy Revision', icon 'fa fa-copy'

rename_revision_note_rfo.control: the 'note' link in a Project Revisions row; opens a note editor — set it to RFO

load_revision_coils.control: the gear/'Details' icon on a Project Revisions row (fa fa-gear); fills the 'Products In Revision' table

open_coil.control: the Unit Name link in a Products In Revision row; the row's 'Tag #' cell is the match key (CDXC-1, ...)

export_report.control: Project Revisions row action, title 'Latest Report', icon 'fa fa-list'
export_report.produces: the revision's report (view/download) — John's exported file, fed into CoilForge's quote package

dom_reads.project_row: In /UserProjects: table rows; project link href = UserProjects/FullDetails/{projectId}; row action icons include fa-newspaper-o (details), fa-edit (/UserProjects/Edit/{id}), fa-times (DeleteProjectDialog).
dom_reads.revision_row: In FullDetails: 'Project Revisions' table; the note cell text is the current revision note; action icons carry CopyRevision / retrieveReport / RetrieveProductsForRevision / DeleteRevision with the real {projectId},{revisionId}.
dom_reads.product_row: 'Products In Revision' table: 'Tag #' cell = coil tag (match key); Unit Name link = editProduct({coilId},'DXCoil').
dom_reads.coil_tag_field: #Tag on /Coils/Edit/{coilId} (the value drawing-param fill/compare run against).

safety: Every action with mutating:true (duplicate_quote, rename_revision_note_rfo, export_report) is confirm_before:true — Claude drives up to the click, shows John exactly the handler + ids, and STOPS for his per-action go-ahead. Login is John's (credentials never entered). Ids are always read from the live DOM, never invented. review_aid_only; never auto-saves a coil.
